honesty_notes: A database is not a source. NBS 514 is ONE editorial source that supplies 186 molecules.
A publisher is not a laboratory. LAB-ACS-<doi> means 'an ACS paper', not 'the same lab measured it', so laboratories remain UNRESOLVED unless a per-paper author block was read.
LiquidBenchmark's rows are ThermoML-derived and carry no per-row DOI; they are recorded as UNRESOLVED independence and may duplicate the frozen set.
ComBat rows are recorded ONLY as rejected evidence (definition mismatch); they never enter any training or evaluation pool.
